scope: Selected fixed-version attack metric, eligibility, repeated-call and results passages only; no full-paper review, attack execution or reproduced statistics.

independent_review.review_scope: Independent read-only inspection of the three retained fixed-version HTML sources at the proposed metric, eligibility, repeated-call and result passages. No fresh HTTP requests, test runs, model calls, attack execution or whole-paper review.

boundaries.jevadvbench: Decisions are compared to clean answers, not independent truth labels. Score uses the most-likely level, not every expected-value change. The retest control and stability-selected, largely model-derived labeling population remain explicit.
boundaries.decision_hijacking: Clean qualification and target eligibility condition the selected cases. Call-level target frequency, any-action flips and five-call majority success have separate denominators. Adaptive-search validation uses fresh calls and does not demonstrate completed harmful execution.
boundaries.same_attack: ASR is conditional on each judge’s clean-flagged malicious cases, so eligible populations can differ. GBR is a separate Jev-only quantity requiring both action relaxation and severity-Score confidence at least 0.7; it need not reach pass and is not stated to be an ASR superset.
boundaries.repeated_calls: Moderation and phishing receive two additional unchanged calls. Raw severity variation is not routed-action variation; author-reported examples are not independently reproduced here.
boundaries.causal_and_delivery_limits: The proposed protocol does not infer causal harm merely from a raw attack rate exceeding retest variation. Equal billed token counts alone do not establish non-delivery; the source explicitly describes billing-based inference and equal-token delivered paraphrases.

independent_review.privacy: Only source URLs, source/proposal hashes and original short scope paraphrases; no raw source bodies, contacts or local cache paths.

parent_passage_review.source: Previously retained fixed-version HTML; no new network fetch.

writing_review.argument: Definitions and denominators precede matched repeat controls and author-reported examples. The proposed protocol is separated from reported experiments.
writing_review.readability: The final survey uses three columns. The guide explains pass/review and severity in Chinese, states at least three validation selections, and cites the direct Score-mode definition. Judge-specific denominators may differ; they are not asserted always to differ.

privacy: Public fixed source links, original short review notes and hashes only; no raw source bodies or cache paths.
